text: On Jack's GPU the server cannot render into a linear XRGB8888 dmabuf: binding fails with 'Failed to bind Framebuffer' and GBM reports the modifier as INVALID. decade reads frames back through the renderer with copy_framebuffer instead: read in src/script.rs, and the screenshot tool in src/server/compositor/screenshot.rs, which renders into a GlesRenderbuffer. Found by trial on 2026-11-07.
